title: How to Find Nameservers in Hostinger 2026 Easily
description:
In today's video, I'm going to teach you How to Find Nameservers in Hostinger 2026 Easily — a process that should take just around 5 minutes.
If you're managing a website, knowing how to find and manage your name servers is crucial. They're a fundamental part of connecting your domain to your web hosting.

So let’s get started.

First, head over to the Hostinger website. Click on the Login button at the top-right corner and enter your credentials. 

After logging in, you'll land on the hPanel dashboard Click on websites.

Find the site you're working on, and click Manage next to it.

On the management page, either scroll down or use the search bar to find Nameservers or DNS Details.

Once you're there, you’ll typically see Hostinger's default nameservers listed as:

ns1.dns-parking.com  
ns2.dns-parking.com  

Simply copy these and paste them wherever your domain is registered, such as GoDaddy, Namecheap, or any third-party registrar.

Same way you can find the similar stuff at domain section of hostinger.

And that’s it!

You’ve successfully located the nameservers for your website using Hostinger's dashboard. This is an essential step when you're trying to point a domain to Hostinger or troubleshoot DNS-related issues.

Always make sure you copy the nameservers exactly as shown—even a small typo can cause domain connection issues.

Thanks for watching. Be sure to like, share, and subscribe for more quick web hosting tutorials and website management tips.
